QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 7 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: Cole needs you to drive the Grays off, since they weren't invited, but be nice enough that they'll still register as Republicans.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Speaking Hall and drive off the Grays!
QuestInfo.2: Zeno and his crew are no more. Return to Cole.

0.0: It's time for the presidential showdown, but the Grays are taking up all the good seats and they don't have tickets. Clear them out for the real guests, okay?

yes.0:
Your face is going to be all over my blog, I can guarantee you that. Actually, I can't, because I forgot my camera. But you're still pretty okay in my book. Here's a little thing for you.

yes.1: I'll call you if we have any more alien trouble. Otherwise, I'll be busy with the show, so my phone will be off!
